title: Spec: 85 of 145 request bodies are not marked `required: true`, so Schemathesis sends "valid" empty bodies the handlers reject — 17 ops, 35 cases per sweep, 15 of them baselined against Done KS-255
description:
## Summary

One for the spec when convenient, Kamil. 85 of the spec's 145 request bodies aren't marked `required: true`, so Schemathesis reasonably sends "valid" requests with no body at all, and 17 operations answer 400 (35 cases per sweep). It isn't a blanket fix: 23 operations happily accept an empty body. So the likely shape is marking `required: true` where the Zod schema rejects an absent body. 15 of these pairs are still baselined against [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints), which is closed, so this would give them a live home. Thank you.

+++ Full evidence

**Sweep 4** (slot 3, seed 1353, 4.28.0, toml loaded): 85 operations with a non-required `requestBody`; 40 were sent a no-body positive case (237 cases); **17 operations / 35 cases** failed `positive_data_acceptance`.

| Operation | No-body cases | Status | Baseline today |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `PATCH /api/platform/tenants/{id}` | 4 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `PATCH /api/users/admin/{id}` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/analytics/reports` | 1 | 400 | not baselined |
| `POST /api/billing/checkout/custom` | 1 | 400 | not baselined |
| `POST /api/billing/customers/{customerId}/default-payment-method` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/issuer-certs` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/m365/documents/sync` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/m365/outlook/verify-hash` | 1 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/m365/sites` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/nft/estimate` | 1 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/nft/record` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/nft/verify/asset` | 1 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/nft/verify/transaction` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/onedrive/files/{id}/sync` | 5 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/referrals/generate` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/users/me/change-password` | 3 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |
| `POST /api/v2/verification/verify` | 2 | 400 | [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) |

Example, `POST /api/billing/checkout/custom` (all four sweeps): body `null` → 400 `"path":["quantity"],"message":"Required"`.

**Direction:** mark `requestBody.required: true` where the handler's Zod schema rejects an absent body, at the generator (`*.openapi.ts` → `npm run generate-openapi`). Optionally, a spec-lint rule: a body whose schema has a non-empty `required` list must itself be `required: true`.

Related: [KS-255](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-255/fix-tighten-openapi-request-schemas-add-400-responses-for-12-endpoints) (Done) · [KS-591](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-591/positive-data-acceptance-recurs-at-scale-734-failures-across-64-ops-ks) · [KS-1015](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1015/sweeps-2026-09-08-28-checkoperation-pairs-have-no-live-owner-18) (finding 2) · [KS-1361](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1361/schemathesis-baselinejson-lags-the-linear-registers-37-of-90-failing).

nodes.title: Evidence: POST /api/identity-credentials/issue, failed vs passed run (2026-10-26)

nodes.body:
**One more operation in this class: `POST /api/identity-credentials/issue`** (not in this ticket's list or KS-1705's).

**Evidence is attached to this ticket** (Resources: *"Evidence: POST /api/identity-credentials/issue, failed vs passed run (2026-10-26)"*). The file holds every case Schemathesis sent to this operation in both runs: request, response and every check result. Credentials are redacted; nothing else is edited. It includes the failing case, the control's passing stateful case, and every no-body request from both runs.

**Measured 2026-10-26** on Peter's Mac, Schemathesis 4.32.1, `pre-merge`, platform-k slot 1, run `pre-merge-ks-955-2026-10-26T16-33-38Z-slot1`, seed 1833334654. That run was on the KS-955 branch, which does not touch the spec or this service.

- The published spec does not mark this operation's request body required (`requestBody.required` is unset). Schemathesis therefore treats a request with no body as valid.
- In the stateful phase it sent exactly that and got a 400. It reported ST202 `positive_data_acceptance` (case `a5Fnkw`):

```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: [Filtered]' http://localhost:6882/api/identity-credentials/issue
→ 400 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"BAD_REQUEST","message":"Validation error: Required, Required"}}
```

## Failed run against passing run: every request this operation received

I compared the KS-955 run (failed) with a develop control the same day (passed). The control ran on platform-k slot 2, built from develop `ec3313a80`, seed 1543992972, run `pre-merge-2026-10-26T17-19-41Z-slot2`.

Every case Schemathesis sent to this operation, read from each run's own `schemathesis-output.ndjson`. Requests are grouped by phase, generation mode, whether a body was sent, and the status returned:

| Phase | Mode | Body | Status | KS-955 run (failed) | Control (passed) |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| coverage | negative | body | 400 | 48 | 48 |
| coverage | negative | body | 401 | 1 | 1 |
| coverage | negative | **no body** | **400** | 1 | 1 |
| coverage | positive | body | 201 | 22 | 22 |
| coverage | positive | body | 415 | 2 | 2 |
| examples | positive | body | 201 | 1 | 1 |
| examples | positive | body | 401 | 2 | 2 |
| fuzzing | negative | body | 400 | 1 | 3 |
| fuzzing | negative | body | 401 | 1 | 0 |
| fuzzing | positive | body | 201 | 4 | 3 |
| **stateful** | **positive** | **no body** | **400** | **1 → ST202 (case `a5Fnkw`)** | 0 |
| stateful | positive | body | 201 | 0 | 1 |

**What this shows:**

- The API answered the same request the same way in both runs. A request with no body got **400** every time (coverage phase, both runs). A valid body got **201** every time.
- The **only** difference is what the stateful phase generated. In the KS-955 run it sent a positive case with **no body**, and because the spec does not require a body, Schemathesis expected a 2xx and flagged the 400. In the control it sent a body and got 201.
- The handler is right to refuse an empty body; the spec is what needs changing. The failure depends on the seed: the same item also appeared in develop runs on 2026-10-21.

**Suggested fix (this ticket's direction):** mark `requestBody.required: true` for this operation in its `*.openapi.ts`, then `npm run generate-openapi`.

**BLUF:** one more operation belongs to this class, not in the table above: `POST /api/timestamps/verify`. Peter asked for it to be added here.

**Measured on 2026-10-16** (slot 2, develop `a92f46e14`, Schemathesis 4.31.1, `pre-merge`): `positive_data_acceptance::POST /api/timestamps/verify` fired. A bodyless request (`curl -X POST …/api/timestamps/verify`, no `-d`) answered **400** `"hash: Required"`. It is the only one of that run's 82 failing pairs that is **not** in `config/schemathesis-baseline.json`; the hand-run baseline gate showed it, since KS-752 still skips the gate.

**Verified from source:**
- `services/timestamping/src/timestamping.openapi.ts:458-463` registers the body with **no `required: true`**.
- The two sibling routes in the same file do mark it (`:309`, `:347`).
- The handler parses with zod (`services/timestamping/src/index.ts:413`), and `TimestampVerifyRequest` requires `hash`, `proof` and `timestampType`.

So the fix is exactly this ticket's direction: `required: true` at the generator, then `npm run generate-openapi`.

**Proposed acceptance criterion for this operation:** after the fix, a test demonstrates it. A targeted Schemathesis `positive_data_acceptance` run on `POST /api/timestamps/verify` no longer fires, and the spec-lint rule suggested above (a body whose schema has a non-empty `required` list must itself be `required: true`) would catch it. Thank you.

**One more operation in this class, 2026-10-07 (KS-1414 runs; platform-k slot 3, Mac, Schemathesis 4.29.4, seed 1414):** `negative_data_rejection::POST /api/documents/{id}/revoke`, **1** case in `full-ks-1414-2026-10-07T11-40-31Z-slot3`, on a stack rebuilt from `develop` `2c27ddfee`. Only the body was negative, no body was sent, and the platform answered 200. The spec's `requestBody` for this operation is not `required` (read from `secuura-api.yaml`), so the sent request was valid, which is this ticket's mechanism. The KS-1414 classifier counts it under "no body (KS-1364 class)": 2 such cases in that run. It wasn't drawn in the two earlier runs that day, so this is a sample, not a measurement. Thank you, Kamil. Posted by agent on Peter's behalf.

## 2026-10-05 (KS-1408 sweeps, Schemathesis 4.29.3): five more operations in this class

**BLUF.** Since this ticket is in progress, Kamil, here's what the 4.29.3 sweeps added to its class: two more operations that **reject** an absent body the spec allows, and three that **accept** an absent body which Schemathesis's `negative_data_rejection` treats as invalid. None of the five specs marks `requestBody.required`. Thank you.

>>> Evidence (slot 4, `develop` `46c3e20cf`, seed 1408)

**Rejects a no-body positive case (`positive_data_acceptance`, 400):**

| Operation | `requestBody.required` | 4.28.0 | 4.29.3 | re-run |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `POST /api/identity-credentials/issue` | not set | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| `PUT /api/nft/admin/platform-fee` | not set | 0 | 1 | 1 |

**Accepts a no-body "negative" case (`negative_data_rejection`, 2xx):**

| Operation | `requestBody.required` | 4.28.0 | 4.29.3 | re-run |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `POST /api/did` | not set | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| `PATCH /api/webhooks/{id}` | not set | 0 | 1 | 2 |
| `POST /api/documents/{id}/revoke` | `false` | 0 | 3 | 0 |

The second group is the mirror image. The published contract permits omitting the body, so these aren't the platform accepting invalid input against the spec. Whether each body *should* be required is this ticket's per-operation decision, same as the 23 operations already noted that accept an empty body.

Run directories: `systemTest/schemathesis/output/reports/full-ks-1408-2026-10-05T09-32-24Z-slot4`, `…T10-23-55Z-slot4`.
